scope: Offline Python-standard-library JSON-file CLI and reusable in-memory text index, built from an empty directory.

interfaces.cli: python -B implementation.py example_input.json; JSON result on stdout, JSON error on stderr and exit 2 for invalid requests.
interfaces.documents: Nonempty list/tuple of objects containing exactly nonblank string id and text. IDs are unique and case-sensitive; text must contain a Unicode word token.
interfaces.request: JSON object with required documents/query, optional top_k/min_score/mode/embeddings; unknown fields and duplicate JSON keys rejected.
interfaces.modes: auto uses embeddings when supplied, otherwise explicitly labeled lexical_tfidf. lexical forces lexical matching; embedding requires a callback.
interfaces.callback: Receives list of {id,text}, returns mapping of exactly those IDs to nonempty numeric list/tuple vectors. Called at construction and per embedding query. Query batch ID is __query__. Finite int/float coordinates only, no booleans; dimensions must match across documents and queries.
interfaces.json_embeddings: Optional embeddings object contains documents (ID-to-vector object) and query (vector); uses the same validated callback path without a provider.
interfaces.ranking: L2-normalized raw-count TF multiplied by log((1+N)/(1+df))+1; cosine similarity. Embedding vectors are robustly normalized before cosine. Scores strictly greater than zero and at least min_score qualify; threshold in [0,1], top_k a positive integer. Ties use ascending case-sensitive document ID.
interfaces.evidence: Exact source substrings with zero-based Python Unicode-character start/end offsets; highlighted_text is HTML escaped with mark elements on whole-token Unicode-casefold matches.
interfaces.empty_results: Whitespace-empty queries are invalid. Nonblank punctuation-only or out-of-vocabulary lexical queries return zero_query_vector. Zero embedding queries also return zero_query_vector. Otherwise no qualifying results return no_match_above_threshold.

limitations: Lexical fallback is lexical matching, not neural semantic understanding; no stemming, synonyms, stopword removal, or language-specific segmentation.
No embedding model or provider is included. Supplied embeddings are validated structurally, not for semantic quality. Synthetic labeled vectors test plumbing, not model accuracy.
Evidence highlights only lexical query-token matches, not causal embedding explanations; embedding matches may have no highlighted evidence.
Full-text evidence output can be large. All documents and vectors remain in memory; exhaustive scoring is linear in stored vector data.
No persistence, incremental update, approximate-nearest-neighbor index, authentication, or resource quotas. JSON files are trusted local workload inputs.
Negative and zero cosine scores are excluded even at threshold zero. Numerical near-ties are ordered by actual float score, not rounded score.
Injected callbacks execute caller code; callback exceptions propagate in the Python API.

coverage: Three labeled lexical queries and three labeled injected-embedding queries
Hand-computed TF-IDF cosine, nonunit embedding cosine, deterministic ties, thresholds and top-k
Exact source offsets, safe HTML highlighting, Unicode and token boundaries
Duplicate and malformed document validation; malformed JSON, duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite constants
Embedding ID, dimensionality and finite-coordinate validation at construction and query time
Zero, negative, orthogonal and extreme-magnitude vectors; missing callback and no-match behavior
Real CLI subprocess, injected-vector CLI input, error exit status and missing-file handling
